name: Pear Chutney
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Mix pears, pepper, raisins, sugar, crystallised ginger, white vinegar, salt, and water in a pot.
Use string to tie spices in a cheesecloth bag and add to pears
Simmer mixture until thick, about 2 hours.
Add liquid pectin and boil for 1 minute.
Pour immediately into hot, sterilised jars, and seal straight away.

culture.text: Pear chutney is served as a side dish for many Indian foods. It can be mild to extra hot depending on the individual preference.
